texts.facts: The plaintiff Bank has filed present suit against defendants seeking recovery of Rs.7,63,660.40/- with interest at the rate of 15.5% per annum from the date of suit till the date of realization. 2. The brief averments of plaint are that: The plaintiff is a bank incorporated under the Indian Companies Act, 1913 having its Registered Head Office at No.112, JC Road, Bangalore District, Karnataka State and a Branch Office amongst others at Binnipet Branch, Bangalore District, Karnataka State Pin Code-560076. The defendant approached the plaintiff bank for a loan of Rs.9,50,000/- for the purpose of business. The plaintiff bank after following necessary formalities of preparing credit investigation report, pre-sanction unit visit report and simplified common Appraisal of Memorandum of MSME loan, sanctioned aforesaid loan of Rs.9,50,000/- to defendants under Loan A/c No.170005058882. Defendants executed letter of undertaking, hypothecation agreement and other necessary loan documents by furnishing registration certificate, GST certificate, FSSAI certificate of their unit along with KYC documents in support of said loan. Thereafter defendants failed to repay the loan, which constrained plaintiff to issue demand notice seeking repayment of entire loan amount of Rs.7,63,660.40 with floating interest prevailing at that time. Despite service of notice, defendants neither cleared outstanding amount nor replied the above notice. Thereafter plaintiff approached DLSA by filing PIM No.1297/2024 and received order dtd.11.09.2024. Hence present suit and it is prayed to decree the same as prayed for. 3. Despite repeated issuance of summons, defendants could not be secured. Thereafter despite issuance of summons by way of News Paper publication in Kannada Prabha Newspaper dtd.23.09.2025, defendants have remained absent and they have been placed exparte. Shikamani, who has entered into witness box as PW.1 and filed his chief examination affidavit by reiterating entire averments of plaint.
